items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: I loved Billy Higgins though too. Billy Higgins.

ctx.x: Who were your biggest influences in terms of drummers?

Oh man, well Philly Joe really and “Billy Boy” man, you know, listen to that one. What’s wrong with that? “Billy Boy” man. And Art Blakey man, in the very beginning Art Blakey was just thundering. And Kenny Clarke man. Brushes? Kenny Clarke, what a player man. I loved Billy Higgins though too. Billy Higgins. And Buddy. I was on the phone with Frank DeVito last night, my cousin who is a drummer from Utica and he’s like 90 now, 91. We were talking about, every once in a while we talk about Buddy Rich. You have to.
